cv.name: Gareth Shepherd
cv.headline: Senior Logistics Coordinator | Aerospace & Defence Supply Chains
cv.summary: Logistics coordinator with eleven years in aerospace and engineering supply chains in the South West. Experienced in time-critical freight, export controls and coordinating suppliers, carriers and production planners.

experience.title: Senior Logistics Coordinator
bullets: Coordinate inbound and outbound freight for a site supplying wing components to European assembly lines
Handle AOG and time-critical shipments, often within four hours of a call
Manage export licences and classifications under UK strategic export controls
Reduced premium freight spend by £310k a year through better forecasting with planning

experience.title: Logistics Coordinator
bullets: Booked road, air and sea freight for engineering customers
Prepared customs documentation and resolved delivery issues

experience.title: Warehouse Team Leader
bullets: Led a team of eight on goods-in and despatch

education.degree: BSc Logistics and Supply Chain Management
education.school: University of the West of England

skills: UK strategic export controls, ITAR awareness
certifications: CILT Diploma in Logistics and Transport, 2018
